name: AW2725Q monitor reference model
purpose: Reference for designing a mount and for layout; not a manufactured part and not the monitor's own CAD model

printed_mm.note: Printed on the drawing. Z values are distances behind the front of the screen (the drawing's Z = 0).

estimated_mm.note: Read off the pictures of the drawing, each scaled by a dimension printed in the same view. The drawing says it is not to scale; the views agree with their printed dimensions within one per cent. Good to about 2 mm at best. To be measured on the monitor.
estimated_mm.housing_shape: Each section of the housing is a superellipse |x/a|^n + |y/b|^n = 1 of the given width, height and exponent n, centred on the pivot axis. The rim is the housing's outline in the rear view; the other sections follow its profile in the top and side views.

mount_collar.note: The raised frame around the mount recess in the rear view. Taken to be what reaches the published depth of 72.63; the drawing does not say where on the back that depth is.

estimated_mm.mount_pattern_centre: on the pivot axis and on the body's vertical centre line

assumed_mm.note: Not on the drawing. A 100 x 100 mm pattern is M4 in the VESA mounting standard; the thread, its depth and the screw length are to be taken from the monitor's manual and checked on the monitor.

not_modelled: The stand and its quick-release plate, which sits in the mount recess.
The lower band of the mount plate at Z = 60.50 and the four openings beside the pads.
The port bay at the bottom of the housing (about 196 mm wide and 50 mm high in the rear view), connectors, cables and the space they need.
Vents, buttons, the joystick, logos, and the true free-form surfaces of the back.
Threads, and anything inside: the model is filled.
